question_text: Explain why a browser and server must follow the same HTTP communication rules, and how HTTPS adds protection.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: Shared HTTP message/request-response rules let each side interpret messages correctly. HTTPS protects that exchange with TLS, providing confidentiality/integrity and server authentication through certificates.
